title: helm(private): values schema + templating fixes for init hooks and rollback
author: Aisha Khan
description: Context: The Private installer Helm chart's init jobs and upgrade/rollback behavior have been a frequent source of flaky upgrades in air-gapped and high-availability customer environments. This PR stabilizes the chart by adding a formal values schema for validation, tightening templating around init job names/labels, and making pre-upgrade hooks robust to partial rollbacks. Motivation: reduce customer upgrade failures, make the values contract machine-validated (CI) and provide clearer rollback semantics for operators. Summary of changes: - Add charts/redwood-private/values.schema.json to validate user-supplied values (initJobs.*, rollout.rollback.strategy, tolerations, affinity blocks). - Extend values.yaml with explicit initJobs.{enabled,image,backoffLimit,affinity,tolerations} and rollout.rollback.* defaults. - Templating fixes in templates/_helpers.tpl and templates/init-job.yaml to ensure stable names and label selectors across upgrades (prevents orphaned pods on rollback). - Convert pre-upgrade hook to a numbered ordered hook and add fail-safe: if hook Job already exists from previous release, we check ownerReferences + label selectors before creating a new Job. - Add helm tests/upgrade-rollback-smoke.yaml to CI to exercise a 2-step upgrade -> rollback scenario in the integration pipeline. - Add unit tests that run helm template against the new schema and validate no forbidden API usage. Commits: ["helm: add values.schema.json and corresponding docs","helm: add initJobs values (enabled,image,backoffLimit,affinity,tolerations)","helm: templating fixes for stable hook/job names and label selectors","helm: make pre-upgrade hook idempotent and safe on rollback","tests: add upgrade-rollback-smoke helm test","docs: document upgrade/rollback guidance in charts/redwood-private/README.md" ]
review_comments: Jonas Meyer (reviewer): Please tighten tolerations schema and add example values - I saw malformed tolerations sent by a customer.
Aisha Khan (author): Updated values.schema.json to require an array of objects for tolerations and added example block in charts/redwood-private/values.schema.example.json
Priya Reddy (reviewer): CI failed on the first run; see helm-integration job logs - hook Job collision on quick rollback.
Aisha Khan (author): Reworked pre-upgrade hook into ordered hook and added ownerReference / label-check guard before creating a Job. Reran CI and integration test passed.
Luca Marinelli (approver): Left a minor nit on README wording about opt-in behavior; non-blocking.
